records.title: Step-level Value Preference Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning
records.reason: Step-level value preference optimization trains reasoning models from step feedback and evaluates mathematical reasoning outcomes. It is a training/objective contribution, not a training-memory system or inference optimization; the ZeRO-Infinity linkage is not a technical connection.

records.title: SciAgent: Tool-augmented Language Models for Scientific Reasoning
records.reason: SciAgent augments language models with tools for scientific reasoning and evaluates task-solving benchmarks. It does not introduce a training offload, memory, or serving optimization; the ZeRO-Infinity relationship is not substantive.

records.title: A Survey of Research in Large Language Models for Electronic Design Automation
records.reason: This survey reviews LLM use and research in electronic design automation, including system/inference context, but proposes no concrete inference optimization. It can support domain scouting but its relation to prompt-compression systems is indirect.

records.title: Thread of Thought Unraveling Chaotic Contexts
records.reason: Thread of Thought is a prompting strategy for reasoning over complex contexts and evaluates answer quality; it does not reduce computational cost, memory, latency, or serving load. A LongNet citation does not establish an efficiency connection.

records.title: Transformers represent belief state geometry in their residual stream
records.reason: The paper analyzes transformer residual-stream representations of belief-state geometry and evaluates interpretability/prediction tasks. It does not present an inference optimization; the multi-token-prediction relation is not a technical efficiency link.
